entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Um, yes. I... I think I need to return something? I'm not really sure how this works. It's all a bit confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, I think so. It's... VF-881-92B. Is that right?
Got it, thank you. I see an order for a VeloFit Aero-Sprint helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's not broken or anything. The website was just... a lot. I picked a color, but when the helmet arrived, it just wasn't what I thought it would be. I haven't even taken it out, the box is unopened right here. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. I understand completely. Getting the right gear is important, especially for something that ensures your safety on the road.
Let me just check the delivery date here... okay, I see it was delivered 71 days ago.
Oh dear, is that too long? I knew I should have called sooner. I just get so overwhelmed.
Not at all. Our standard return policy is 90 days. So at 71 days, you are well within the window for a full refund. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! I was so worried it would be a problem. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help, David. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
